_note: Hosted connector: no public source, so the catalogue is transcribed from the vendor docs. `mcp-audit matrix` refetches _source and checks every name against it, marking any that is not on the page.

tools.name: wpcom-user-sites
tools.description: List WordPress.com and Jetpack-connected sites available to the authenticated user; supports search, status and privacy filters, pagination and optional metrics.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-content-authoring -> action: list / describe
tools.description: Facade discovery interface: list returns the operation catalogue, describe returns the full JSON Schema for one operation.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-site-editor-context -> action: list / describe
tools.description: Facade discovery interface for site design context; this facade uses list / describe / get and never writes.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-site -> action: list / describe
tools.description: Facade discovery interface for site settings, stats, plugins, activity, themes and Jetpack modules.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-account -> action: list / describe
tools.description: Facade discovery interface for account-level operations; operates on the authenticated user, no site parameter.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-content-authoring -> posts.list
tools.description: List posts with filters for status, author, search, taxonomy, date range, ordering and pagination.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-content-authoring -> posts.get
tools.description: Get a single post by ID or slug; falls back to searching pages if the slug does not match a post.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-content-authoring -> posts.create
tools.description: Create a new post; created as draft by default.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-content-authoring -> posts.update
tools.description: Update an existing post; only supplied fields change. If status is publish, changes go live immediately.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-content-authoring -> posts.delete
tools.description: Move a post to trash; restorable from WP admin within 30 days.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-content-authoring -> pages.list
tools.description: List pages with filters for parent, status, search, ordering and pagination.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-content-authoring -> pages.get
tools.description: Get a single page by ID or slug.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-content-authoring -> pages.create
tools.description: Create a new page as draft; supports hierarchical structures and page templates.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-content-authoring -> pages.update
tools.description: Update an existing page; publish status makes changes live immediately.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-content-authoring -> pages.delete
tools.description: Move a page to trash; restorable within 30 days.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-content-authoring -> comments.list
tools.description: List comments with filters for status, post, author, search, date range and pagination.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-content-authoring -> comments.get
tools.description: Get a single comment by ID.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-content-authoring -> comments.create
tools.description: Create a comment on a post; author fields auto-populate for authenticated users.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-content-authoring -> comments.update
tools.description: Update an existing comment; approved status makes it visible immediately.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-content-authoring -> comments.delete
tools.description: Move a comment to trash.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-content-authoring -> media.list
tools.description: List media items with filters for mime type, post, author, search, date range and pagination.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-content-authoring -> media.get
tools.description: Get a single media item by ID.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-content-authoring -> media.create
tools.description: Upload a new media item (image, video, audio, document).

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-content-authoring -> media.update
tools.description: Update media metadata, not the file itself; alt_text and caption changes apply immediately everywhere the media is used.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-content-authoring -> media.delete
tools.description: Move a media item to trash; may break content that references it.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-content-authoring -> categories.list
tools.description: List categories with optional filters.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-content-authoring -> categories.get
tools.description: Get a single category by ID.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-content-authoring -> categories.create
tools.description: Create a new category; supports parent-child hierarchy.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-content-authoring -> categories.update
tools.description: Update a category; changing the slug changes archive URLs immediately and may break links.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-content-authoring -> categories.delete
tools.description: Permanently delete a category - taxonomy terms have no trash. Assigned posts move to Uncategorized and child categories become top-level.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-content-authoring -> tags.list
tools.description: List tags with optional filters; tag search is case-insensitive.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-content-authoring -> tags.get
tools.description: Get a single tag by ID.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-content-authoring -> tags.create
tools.description: Create a new tag.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-content-authoring -> tags.update
tools.description: Update a tag; changing the slug changes archive URLs immediately.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-content-authoring -> tags.delete
tools.description: Permanently delete a tag; removed from all associated posts.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-content-authoring -> patterns.list
tools.description: List block patterns available on the site (theme, core, pattern directory).

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-content-authoring -> patterns.get
tools.description: Get a single block pattern by name, including its block markup.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-content-authoring -> synced-patterns.list
tools.description: List the site's synced (reusable) patterns.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-content-authoring -> synced-patterns.get
tools.description: Get a single synced pattern by ID, including block markup.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-content-authoring -> content-search
tools.description: Free-text search across the site's content: posts, pages and other post types.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-site-editor-context -> theme.active
tools.description: Get the active theme's stylesheet slug and name.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-site-editor-context -> theme.presets
tools.description: Get the site's design tokens: colour palette, font sizes, font families, gradients, spacing scale.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-site-editor-context -> theme.styles
tools.description: Get applied styles from theme.json: block-level overrides and element-level typography and colours.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-site-editor-context -> blocks.allowed
tools.description: List block types registered on the site with name, title, description, category and style variations.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-site -> settings.get
tools.description: Read general, writing, reading, discussion, media, permalink and privacy settings.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-site -> settings.update
tools.description: Update site settings.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-site -> statistics.get
tools.description: Site totals (published posts, pages, subscribers) plus optional views, visitors and publishing counts for a date range.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-site -> plugin.list
tools.description: List installed plugins with status, version, update availability and permissions.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-site -> activity.get
tools.description: Activity log entries (posts, comments, plugin updates, backups, user actions), reverse-chronological, default last 6 months.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-site -> theme.list
tools.description: List installed themes on the site.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-site -> theme.set
tools.description: Switch the active theme.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-site -> monitor.status
tools.description: Jetpack Monitor uptime check status.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-site -> monitor.activate
tools.description: Activate Jetpack Monitor.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-site -> monitor.deactivate
tools.description: Deactivate Jetpack Monitor.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-site -> newsletter.status
tools.description: Jetpack Newsletter status.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-site -> newsletter.get_settings
tools.description: Jetpack Newsletter settings.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-site -> account-protection.status
tools.description: Jetpack Account Protection status.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-site -> account-protection.activate
tools.description: Activate Jetpack Account Protection.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-site -> account-protection.deactivate
tools.description: Deactivate Jetpack Account Protection.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-site -> manage-site.status
tools.description: Site lifecycle status (coming-soon, visibility).

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-site -> manage-site.launch
tools.description: Launch the site.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-site -> manage-site.set-visibility
tools.description: Change site visibility.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-account -> profile.get
tools.description: Basic profile: username, email, display name, avatar, locale, timezone; optionally preferences, stats and activity data.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-account -> profile.update
tools.description: Update profile fields such as display name, bio and locale.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-account -> notifications.get
tools.description: Notification preferences across email, push and timeline channels, including device list.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-account -> notifications.update
tools.description: Update notification settings.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-account -> inbox.get
tools.description: The user's notification inbox: messages, alerts, mentions, likes, follows.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-account -> achievements.get
tools.description: Earned badges, feats, gamification progress and trophy case.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-account -> domains.list
tools.description: List the user's domains across all sites.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-account -> domains.get
tools.description: Domain details: management capabilities, DNS configuration, DNSSEC, SSL status.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-account -> domains.dns_records
tools.description: DNS records for a single domain.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-account -> domains.set_primary
tools.description: Set a custom domain as a site's primary domain.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-account -> connections.get
tools.description: Social and third-party service connections, including health tests.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-account -> security.get
tools.description: Security status: 2FA, application passwords, active sessions, login history, account age.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-account -> currency.preview
tools.description: Preview the impact of changing account currency; does not commit.

tools.name: wpcom-mcp-account -> currency.change
tools.description: Change the account currency.

tools.name: wpcom-domain-purchase
tools.description: Search available domains and generate checkout links for registration.

tools.name: wpcom-domain-update-dns-records
tools.description: Add or remove DNS records (A, AAAA, ALIAS, CAA, CNAME, MX, NS, SRV, TXT) for a managed domain.

tools.name: wpcom-domain-restore-default-dns-records
tools.description: Restore WordPress.com default A records or the default www CNAME for a domain.

tools.name: wpcom-domain-update-nameservers
tools.description: Set nameservers for a custom domain (2 to 13 hostnames).

tools.name: wpcom-domain-set-mail-service
tools.description: Configure DNS for an external mail service (Google Workspace, iCloud Mail, Office 365, Zoho Mail).

tools.name: wpcom-checkout-url
tools.description: Generate a pre-configured checkout URL for products or a subscription renewal.

tools.name: wpcom-plans-list
tools.description: List WordPress.com plans with prices and per-tier feature lists.
